stem: Universities are under growing pressure to ____ a larger share of their limited research funding to projects that address urgent environmental problems.
explain_zh: allocate 指把有限資源（經費、時間、土地）按計畫分配出去，後面常接 to。Task 2 談政府預算、教育資源或醫療支出該怎麼分時幾乎一定用到這個字。alleviate 是減輕痛苦、advocate 是主張、aggregate 是加總，都不能接「把錢分給某計畫」。

stem: Renewable sources now ____ nearly a third of the country's electricity supply, a figure that has doubled over the past ten years.
explain_zh: constitute 是及物動詞，意思是「構成、佔」，Task 1 描述圓餅圖或比例時很好用，例如 X constitutes 30% of the total。consist 要寫成 consist of 才對，後面不能直接接受詞；institute 是設立制度、substitute 是替換，語意都不合。

stem: Before the new railway line was approved, engineers had to ____ a detailed survey of the wetlands that the route would cross.
explain_zh: undertake 表示「著手進行、承擔（調查、研究、工作）」，是雅思閱讀學術文章的高頻字，undertake a study/survey/project 是固定搭配。undergo 是被動地經歷某事（工程師不是被調查的人）、overtake 是超越、partake 是參與分享，都不能接 a survey。

stem: Many of the medicines prescribed in hospitals today ____ from plants that indigenous communities have used for hundreds of years.
explain_zh: derive from 意思是「源自、衍生自」，寫作談某個制度、字詞或產品的來源時最常用，例如 The word derives from Latin。deprive 要說 deprive somebody of something（剝奪），arrive 和 strive 後面都不接 from 表示來源。

stem: A policy may look convincing on paper, but many governments simply lack the funding and the political will to ____ it effectively.
explain_zh: implement 是「實施、落實（政策、計畫）」，Task 2 寫「政府應該推動某政策」時，implement a policy 比 do a policy 高分得多。implicate 是牽連某人涉案、imply 是暗示、complement 是補足，都不能拿來搭配 policy。

stem: The initial trial involved only fifty patients, but ____ studies confirmed the same result with a much larger and more varied sample.
explain_zh: subsequent 是「後續的、隨後的」，閱讀文章描述研究先後順序時常出現 subsequent research/years/experiments。consequent 強調「因此造成的結果」、sequential 是按順序排列的、subordinate 是下屬的，都不是單純表示時間上的後來。

stem: Applicants are ranked according to three ____ : their academic record, their relevant work experience, and a short statement of purpose.
explain_zh: criteria 是 criterion 的複數，前面有 three 就必須用複數。雅思閱讀的招生、評分、審查類文章很愛用 meet the criteria（符合標準）。criterion 是單數與 three 衝突，crises（危機）與 phenomena（現象）語意不合。

stem: Urban heat islands are a well-documented ____ in which city centres remain several degrees warmer than the countryside that surrounds them.
explain_zh: phenomenon 是單數「現象」，前面有 a 就只能用單數形。雅思閱讀的自然科學與社會科學文章常用 a common phenomenon 來介紹要討論的現象。phenomena 是複數與 a 衝突；hypothesis 是待驗證的假設、consensus 是共識，都不是「現象」。

stem: The research team set out to test the ____ that students who sleep for eight hours perform better in timed academic writing tasks.
explain_zh: hypothesis 是「假設」，也就是研究開始前提出、還要靠實驗驗證的說法，test/support/reject a hypothesis 都是閱讀常見搭配。analysis 是分析、emphasis 是強調、synthesis 是綜合，雖然字尾都是 -sis，卻都不能被 test。

stem: The report proposes a legal ____ within which private companies can operate renewable energy plants without excessive interference from the state.
explain_zh: framework 指抽象的「架構、框架」，a legal/theoretical/policy framework 是學術寫作固定用法，Task 2 談制度設計時很好用。frame 多半是具體的框子、network 是網絡、groundwork 是前置準備工作，都不能說 a legal ___。

stem: The difference between the two teaching groups was small but statistically ____ , which suggests that the new method really does have an effect.
explain_zh: statistically significant（統計上顯著）是固定術語，雅思閱讀的研究類文章幾乎一定會出現。considerable、noticeable、remarkable 雖然都有「明顯的」意思，卻不能和 statistically 搭配，而且題目已說 small，用「相當大的」也自相矛盾。

stem: The two universities plan to ____ a joint research centre that will focus on air quality in the fast-growing cities of Southeast Asia.
explain_zh: establish 是「設立、建立（機構、制度、關係）」，也常用在 establish a link between A and B。Task 2 談機構或制度時很好用。estimate 是估計數字、stabilise 是使穩定、distinguish 是分辨，都不能接 a research centre。

stem: Regular exercise, a balanced diet and adequate sleep all ____ to a much lower risk of heart disease in later life.
explain_zh: contribute to 是「有助於、造成」，Task 2 論述因果時比 cause 更謹慎，也更像學術語氣。attribute 要寫 attribute A to B（把 A 歸因於 B），主詞用法不同；distribute 是分發；tribute 是名詞（致敬），詞性就錯了。

stem: The school has adopted a very different ____ to language teaching, one that places speaking practice well before formal grammar drills.
explain_zh: approach 當名詞是「做法、方式」，固定搭配是 an approach to (doing) something，Task 2 比較兩種做法時非常實用。access to 是「取得管道」、aspect 是面向、attempt 是嘗試一次，語意都不是「處理事情的方式」。

stem: Cost is only one ____ influencing whether families decide to send their children to private schools rather than to the local state system.
explain_zh: factor 是「因素」，指會影響結果的變數，key/major/decisive factor 都是雅思寫作常見組合。effect 是造成的結果而不是原因、fact 是事實、feature 是特徵，都不能說 one ___ influencing something。

stem: Economists doubt whether such rapid growth can be ____ once the government withdraws the subsidies that currently support the industry.
explain_zh: sustain 是「維持（成長、水準、生命）」，被動的 be sustained 在討論經濟或環境時很常見，名詞 sustainability 更是雅思核心主題字。restrain 是克制、contain 是抑制或包含、constrain 是限制，意思正好相反。

stem: Many rural clinics still lack ____ equipment, and patients with serious conditions must travel for several hours to reach a city hospital.
explain_zh: adequate 是形容詞「足夠的」，放在名詞 equipment 前面；Task 2 談資源不足時常寫 lack adequate funding/training/facilities。adequately 與 accurately 是副詞不能修飾名詞，adaptable 是「適應力強的」，語意不合。

stem: The chart below ____ the main stages in the production of cement, from the raw material to the packaging of the finished product.
explain_zh: illustrate 是「（圖表）顯示、說明」，Task 1 開頭改寫題目時最常用 The chart illustrates/shows/depicts。illuminate 是照亮、eliminate 是消除、alleviate 是減輕，雖然都是學術字，卻不能用來描述圖表內容。

stem: Although the data came from four separate surveys carried out in different years, the results were remarkably ____ , which strengthens the conclusion.
explain_zh: consistent 是「一致的、前後吻合的」，講不同研究結果互相吻合就用 be consistent with，也可以用來稱讚作文結構前後一致。persistent 是持續不斷的、insistent 是堅持要求的、resistant 是有抵抗力的，都不是「彼此一致」。

stem: A clear pattern began to ____ only after the researchers compared literacy rates in the coastal provinces with those recorded inland.
explain_zh: emerge 是「浮現、顯現出來」，閱讀文章描述資料分析結果時常說 a pattern/trend emerges。merge 是合併、submerge 是沉入水中、urge 是敦促，都不能用來說「規律慢慢出現」。

stem: Students who have no ____ knowledge of statistics may find the second half of this course extremely demanding, especially the final assessment.
explain_zh: prior 是形容詞「事先的、先前的」，prior knowledge/experience 是課程說明和學術文章的固定用法，也可以寫 prior to（在……之前）。previously 是副詞不能修飾名詞，primary 是主要的，preferable 是較可取的，語意都不對。

stem: The committee has called for a ____ review of the whole examination system rather than a series of small and unconnected adjustments.
explain_zh: comprehensive 是「全面的、涵蓋一切的」，a comprehensive review/study/plan 在雅思寫作談政策檢討時很好用。comprehensible 是「能被理解的」、comprehending 是現在分詞、comprised 要接 of，三者都不能表示「全面」。

stem: The instructions were not ____ enough, so almost half of the candidates described the wrong chart in Task 1 of the writing paper.
explain_zh: explicit 是「明確說出來的」，學術寫作常說 make the criteria explicit（把標準說清楚）。implicit 意思相反，是「沒有明講的」；explicable 是可解釋的；expressive 是富有表情的，放進句子都講不通。

stem: Researchers must ____ written consent from every participant before any personal data can be collected, stored or analysed for the project.
explain_zh: obtain 是「取得（文件、許可、資料）」，obtain permission/consent/data 是研究類文章的固定搭配。attain 是達到目標或水準、retain 是保留已有的東西、detain 是拘留，都不能用來說「向別人取得同意書」。

stem: The old power station will ____ a two-year conversion before it reopens as a public gallery and a space for community events.
explain_zh: undergo 是「（被動地）經歷、接受（改造、手術、測試）」，主詞通常是被處理的那一方，例如 undergo repairs/treatment/change。undertake 是主動去執行工作，發電廠不會自己動工；overcome 是克服、overlook 是忽略，語意都不合。

stem: The proposal to charge drivers for entering the city centre remains highly ____ , with business owners and environmental groups taking opposite positions.
explain_zh: controversial 是形容詞「引發爭議的」，Task 2 開頭常寫 This is a highly controversial issue。controversy 是名詞不能放在 highly 後面當主詞補語；convertible 是可轉換的；conventional 是傳統的，都不能表示「有爭議」。

stem: The ____ cause of the shortage is not a lack of land for building but the speed at which property prices have risen since 2010.
explain_zh: underlying 是「潛在的、根本的」，the underlying cause/reason/assumption 在論說文裡用來區分表面現象和真正原因。underlined 是畫底線的、undermined 是被削弱的、underestimated 是被低估的，都不能表示「根本的」。

stem: Some degree of disagreement is ____ when a committee brings together specialists from academic backgrounds as different as law, biology and economics.
explain_zh: inevitable 是形容詞「無可避免的」，It is inevitable that... 在 Task 2 談科技或都市化的必然結果時很常用。invaluable 是「極寶貴的」、invisible 是看不見的，語意不合；inevitably 是副詞不能當 be 動詞的補語。

stem: Plastic waste continues to ____ on the seabed, where the low temperature slows down the process of decomposition almost completely.
explain_zh: accumulate 是「逐漸累積」，環境主題的閱讀與寫作常說 waste/debt/evidence accumulates。circulate 是循環流動、calculate 是計算、speculate 是臆測，都不能描述垃圾一層層堆積。

stem: The workforce in the care sector is still ____ female, although the proportion of male employees has risen slightly since the year 2010.
explain_zh: predominantly 是副詞「絕大多數是、主要是」，描述人口或勞動力組成時很常用，例如 a predominantly rural population。predominant 與 dominant 是形容詞不能修飾 female 這個補語結構；prominently 是「顯眼地」，語意不對。

stem: Between 2005 and 2015 the number of international students at the university ____ from just under four hundred to more than three thousand.
explain_zh: soar 是「急速攀升」，Task 1 描述折線圖或長條圖出現大幅上升時最常用，語氣比 increase 生動得多。slid、dipped、eased 全部都是下降或趨緩的意思，和題目中從 400 漲到 3,000 的數字完全矛盾。

stem: After the new tax was introduced, sales of large petrol cars ____ , falling by almost two thirds within a single financial year.
explain_zh: plummet 是「暴跌」，Task 1 看到線條幾乎垂直往下掉時就用它，常搭配 sharply、dramatically。climb 是上升、hover 是在某個數值附近徘徊、level 要接 off 才是持平，都無法表達「掉了三分之二」。

stem: Rainfall in the region did not follow any clear trend; instead it ____ sharply from one year to the next throughout the whole period.
explain_zh: fluctuate 是「上下起伏、忽高忽低」，Task 1 遇到鋸齒狀的線條就寫 fluctuated wildly/sharply，是拿高分很好用的字。plateau 是持平不動、accelerate 是加速、accumulate 是累積，都不能描述忽上忽下。

stem: Car ownership rose quickly during the 1990s but began to ____ after 2005, remaining at about five hundred vehicles per thousand people.
explain_zh: level off 是「趨於平緩、持平」，Task 1 描述線條先漲後變水平時的標準說法，也可以用 plateau 或 stabilise。take off 是起飛、暴增，set off 是出發，cut off 是切斷，和後半句「維持在 500 左右」互相矛盾。

stem: Visitor numbers ____ at 2.4 million in 2018 before falling back to roughly the level that had been recorded at the start of the period.
explain_zh: peak 當動詞是「達到最高點」，固定用法是 peak at + 數字，Task 1 指出最高點時一定用得到。bottom 要接 out 且意思是觸底、summit 不用來描述數據、maximise 是「使最大化」屬於人為動作，都不適合。

stem: The difference between the two age groups was ____ , amounting to less than one percentage point across the entire national survey.
explain_zh: marginal 是「微乎其微的」，Task 1 遇到幾乎看不出來的差距就寫 a marginal difference/increase。massive 是巨大的、moderate 是中等的、marked 是「明顯的」，三者都和「不到一個百分點」衝突。

stem: There was a ____ increase in electricity generated from wind, which rose from twelve to thirty-eight terawatt hours over the decade.
explain_zh: substantial 是「大幅的、可觀的」，a substantial increase/rise 是 Task 1 形容大幅變化的安全牌。slight 是輕微的、subtle 是細微難察覺的、superficial 是表面的，都無法形容三倍以上的成長。

stem: Between 1990 and 2020 the proportion of households with internet access showed a ____ rise of roughly two percentage points every year.
explain_zh: steady 是「穩定的、平穩的」，Task 1 看到斜率固定、沒有大起大落的線就寫 a steady rise/decline。steep 是陡峭的、erratic 是毫無規律的、abrupt 是突然的，都和「每年約兩個百分點」的規律成長不符。

stem: In contrast to the sudden jump recorded in 2010, the recovery that followed was ____ , taking almost eight years to reach the earlier figure.
explain_zh: gradual 是「逐步的、緩慢的」，和前面的 sudden jump 形成對比，Task 1 常寫 a gradual decline 或 gradually。instant 是立即的、drastic 是劇烈的、momentary 是短暫的，都和「花了八年」的敘述互相抵觸。

stem: The chart shows a ____ drop in newspaper circulation after 2008, when a large number of readers moved to free online news services.
explain_zh: sharp 是「急遽的」，a sharp drop/fall/rise 是 Task 1 最常用的搭配之一，也可以換成 dramatic、steep。shallow 通常形容深度、flat 是持平、mild 是溫和的，都不能形容急速下滑。

stem: Unemployment ____ stable at about five percent for most of the period before rising suddenly in the final year covered by the graph.
explain_zh: remain 是連綴動詞，後面直接接形容詞，remain stable/steady/unchanged 是 Task 1 描述持平的標準句型。maintain 與 preserve 都是及物動詞，後面要接受詞不能接形容詞；insist 更是語意不合。

stem: Coal still ____ for nearly half of the country's electricity supply, despite heavy investment in both solar and wind power since 2015.
explain_zh: account for 是「佔（比例）」，Task 1 描述圓餅圖比例時最實用的片語，例如 X accounts for 40% of the total。count 與 amount 都不能接 for 表示比例（amount to 才是「總計」），constitute 後面不加 for。

stem: Spending on health and on education rose to eighteen and twelve percent of the national budget ____ , while defence spending fell slightly.
explain_zh: respectively 是「分別地」，Task 1 一句話交代兩組數字時用它可以省下很多字，例如 A and B rose to 18% and 12% respectively。respectfully 是「恭敬地」、relatively 是相對地、accordingly 是因此，都不能表示一一對應。

stem: Online sales are expected to ____ high-street sales by 2030, reversing a pattern that has lasted for more than a hundred years.
explain_zh: overtake 是「超越、趕過」，Task 1 描述兩條線交叉、後來者居上時一定用得到，例如 Japan overtook Germany in 2012。overlook 是忽略、overturn 是推翻決定、overcome 是克服困難，都不能用來比較兩組數據的高低。

stem: The number of cars registered on the island ____ between 2000 and 2020, rising from roughly thirty thousand to just over sixty thousand.
explain_zh: double 當動詞是「變成兩倍」，Task 1 遇到數字剛好翻倍時用它最精準，也可以寫 tripled、quadrupled。halve 是減半、stagnate 是停滯不前、deteriorate 是惡化，都和 30,000 漲到 60,000 相反。

stem: Sales reached a ____ of just twelve hundred units in 2013 before recovering steadily over the five years that followed.
explain_zh: trough 是「谷底、最低點」，和 peak 正好是一對，Task 1 指出線條最低處時可以寫 reach a trough of。peak 是最高點、plateau 是平原期、surge 是暴增，三個都和「之後才慢慢回升」的最低點語意衝突。

stem: A sudden ____ in demand for bicycles during 2020 left many shops unable to keep up with the orders they received from customers.
explain_zh: surge 當名詞是「激增」，a surge in demand/numbers 在 Task 1 與 Task 2 都很常見。slump 是衰退、dip 是小幅下滑、lag 是落後，都無法解釋為什麼店家會來不及供貨。

stem: The tourism industry on the island experienced a severe ____ in 2009, from which it took almost a decade to recover completely.
explain_zh: slump 是「（景氣或數字）大幅下滑」，常搭配 severe、sharp，之後多半接 recover。boom 是繁榮、spike 是突然的尖峰、leap 是躍升，三者都是往上走，和「花了十年才恢復」矛盾。

stem: The change in the birth rate over these five years was ____ , which is why the line on the graph appears to be almost completely flat.
explain_zh: negligible 是「小到可以忽略不計的」，Task 1 遇到幾乎沒有變化的線條時，寫 the change was negligible 比 very small 更學術。neglected 是被忽視的（指人或事物被冷落）、considerable 與 noticeable 都表示變化明顯，和「幾乎持平」相反。

stem: By the final year of the survey, imports ____ exports for the first time, creating a trade deficit of almost eight billion dollars.
explain_zh: exceed 是「超過（某數量）」，Task 1 比較兩組數字時很常用，例如 The figure exceeded 50% in 2018。excel 是表現優異（要接 at/in）、extend 是延長、expand 是擴張，都不能直接接受詞表示「數量上多於」。

stem: The author ____ that standardised testing narrows the curriculum, but she offers surprisingly little evidence to support such a strong claim.
explain_zh: assert 是「斷言、強硬主張」，閱讀的 True/False/Not Given 題常靠這個字判斷作者語氣有多肯定。assure 是向某人保證（後面要接人）、ascertain 是查明確認、assemble 是組裝集合，都不能接 that 子句表達主張。

stem: Supporters of the scheme ____ that congestion charges reduce traffic in the centre, while opponents point to the extra cost for low-income drivers.
explain_zh: contend 是「主張、論稱」，語氣比 say 正式，Task 2 引述雙方立場時可以寫 Supporters contend that...。concede 是「勉強承認對方說得對」，支持者不會用來講自己的論點；comply 要接 with；confide 是吐露祕密。

stem: No single study can completely ____ a theory that has been supported by decades of careful observation in more than a dozen countries.
explain_zh: refute 是「駁倒、舉證推翻」，論說文寫「反駁對方論點」時用 refute an argument/claim 最精準。refuse 是拒絕（拒絕做某事），是台灣學生最常誤用的字；renounce 是宣布放棄、revoke 是撤銷許可，都不能用來推翻理論。

stem: A single careless error in the data can seriously ____ the credibility of an otherwise carefully conducted piece of research.
explain_zh: undermine 是「削弱、動搖（信心、論點、地位）」，Task 2 反駁對方時很好用，例如 This evidence undermines the argument that...。underline 是強調、undergo 是經歷、underestimate 是低估，語意都不是「削弱」。

stem: Journalists are expected to ____ their claims with documents or named sources rather than relying on rumour and anonymous comments.
explain_zh: substantiate 是「提出證據證實」，固定搭配 substantiate a claim with evidence，是學術寫作的高階字。substitute 是替換、subsidise 是補貼、sustain 是維持，都不能用來表示「拿證據支持說法」。

stem: The evidence linking air pollution to childhood asthma is now so ____ that several European cities have banned older diesel vehicles.
explain_zh: compelling 是「有說服力的、強而有力的」，compelling evidence/argument/reason 是論說文最漂亮的搭配之一。compulsory 是「強制的」（指規定）、compelled 是被迫的（用在人身上）、competing 是互相競爭的，語意都不對。

stem: The explanation given in the article sounds ____ , but it has never actually been tested under properly controlled laboratory conditions.
explain_zh: plausible 是「聽起來合理、貌似可信」，常帶一點「還沒被證實」的保留語氣，很適合 Task 2 討論對方論點。plentiful 是充足的、permissible 是被允許的、praiseworthy 是值得稱讚的，都不能形容一個解釋的可信度。

stem: Even the strongest defenders of the policy must ____ that it has done very little to reduce waiting times in rural hospitals.
explain_zh: concede 是「（不情願地）承認對方有理」，Task 2 寫讓步段時很加分，例如 It must be conceded that...。conceal 是隱藏、consent 是同意去做某事（要接 to）、convince 要接人當受詞，都不能接 that 表示「承認缺點」。

stem: A growing number of economists now ____ a four-day working week, arguing that shorter hours need not reduce a company's total output.
explain_zh: advocate 是「公開主張、倡導」，後面可以直接接名詞或動名詞，Task 2 介紹某派立場時很好用。allocate 是分配、alleviate 是減輕、aggravate 是使惡化，都不能拿來表示「支持某項制度」。

stem: It would be unwise to ____ these findings simply because the sample happened to be drawn from a single city.
explain_zh: dismiss 是「不予理會、否定掉」，dismiss an argument/idea as... 是論說文常見句型。disclose 是揭露資訊、display 是展示、discourage 是使人打消念頭，都不能表示「輕易否定一項研究結果」。

stem: The writer does ____ the limitations of her method, but she still draws conclusions that the data cannot fully support.
explain_zh: acknowledge 是「承認（事實、限制、對方觀點）」，Task 2 讓步時寫 It is widely acknowledged that... 非常自然。accuse 要接人並搭配 of、account 要接 for、announce 是公開宣布，語氣與用法都不合。

stem: The figures do not prove that the policy caused the change; at most they ____ a connection that is worth investigating further.
explain_zh: imply 是「（話語或資料）暗示」，主詞是資料本身；infer 則是「（人）從資料推論出」，主詞必須是人，這組混淆是雅思寫作最常見的錯誤之一。apply 是應用、employ 是雇用或運用，語意都不合。

stem: The total cost of the project is enormous, and the government has yet to ____ it to taxpayers in any convincing way.
explain_zh: justify 是「為……提出正當理由」，Task 2 寫 The policy can be justified on economic grounds 非常好用。verify 是查證真偽、testify 是出庭作證、clarify 是把話說清楚，都不是「說明某事為何正當」。

stem: An argument can be logically ____ and still reach a false conclusion if one of the assumptions it starts from is wrong.
explain_zh: valid 是「站得住腳的、有效的」，a valid argument/point/reason 是論說文常見搭配，反義是 invalid 或 flawed。vague 是模糊不清的、vital 是至關重要的、verbal 是口頭的，都不能形容推論是否成立。

stem: The study turned out to be seriously ____ , because the researchers had quietly ignored every single case that did not fit their original prediction.
explain_zh: flawed 是「有缺陷的」，a seriously flawed study/argument 是批評研究或論點時的固定說法。flawless 意思完全相反（完美無瑕）、flattering 是討人喜歡的、flexible 是有彈性的，都和「刻意忽略不利資料」的語境衝突。

stem: The whole argument rests on the ____ that people always act in their own economic interest, which many psychologists now question.
explain_zh: premise 是「前提」，也就是論證開始前先假定成立的東西，on the premise that... 是學術用語。promise 是承諾，和 premise 只差一個字母卻意思完全不同，是常見拼字陷阱；premium 是保費或額外費用、presence 是存在。

stem: Critics argue that the report tends to ____ the benefits of the scheme while saying almost nothing about its long-term costs.
explain_zh: overstate 是「誇大」，寫 The article overstates the risks 可以精準表達批評。understate 是「輕描淡寫」，和後半句「幾乎不談成本」的偏袒方向相反；overlook 是忽略（就不會講到 benefits 了）、overcome 是克服。

stem: A strong essay does not ignore opposing views; it states them clearly and then ____ them with evidence drawn from reliable sources.
explain_zh: counter 當動詞是「反駁、回應對方論點」，Task 2 的讓步反駁段最需要這個字。encounter 是遇到、account 要接 for、recount 是敘述經過，字形相近但都不能表示「提出反證」。

stem: Without a named author or any list of sources, the website is simply not a ____ source to cite in an academic essay.
explain_zh: credible 是「可信的」，形容資料來源或說法；academic writing 常說 a credible source。credulous 是「容易輕信別人的」，形容人不是形容來源；creditable 是值得讚許的；incredible 口語上多半是「棒極了」，語氣完全不對。

stem: A good report should remain ____ , presenting both sides fairly rather than selecting only the facts that happen to suit the writer.
explain_zh: objective 是「客觀的」，學術寫作要求 an objective analysis，Task 2 的 discuss both views 題型尤其需要這種語氣。subjective 意思相反是主觀的、objectionable 是令人反感的、obligatory 是義務性的，都不合語境。

stem: The company's annual report devotes an entire chapter to ____ , explaining how it intends to reach net zero emissions before 2040.
explain_zh: sustainability 是「永續性」，環境題組的核心名詞，Task 2 談企業或城市發展時常寫 environmental sustainability。sustenance 是食物營養、subsistence 是勉強糊口的生活、sustainably 是副詞，介系詞 to 後面要接名詞。

stem: Rapid ____ has left many Asian cities struggling to provide enough housing, schools and clean water for the new arrivals from the countryside.
explain_zh: urbanisation 是「都市化」，指人口從鄉村移入城市的過程，是雅思城市與人口題組的必備名詞。urbanity 是指人「談吐優雅」、urgency 是緊迫性、urbanised 是形容詞，都不能當 rapid 後面的主詞名詞。

stem: ____ has made it possible for a company to design a product in Europe, manufacture it in Asia and sell it all over the world.
explain_zh: globalisation 是「全球化」，Task 2 談經濟、文化、語言議題時最常出現的主題字。localisation 是「在地化」方向相反、colonisation 是殖民、generalisation 是以偏概全的通則，都無法解釋跨國分工的現象。

stem: Even before the earthquake, the region's transport ____ was in poor condition, with many of its bridges more than fifty years old.
explain_zh: infrastructure 是「基礎建設」，指道路、橋梁、電力、網路等公共系統，Task 2 談政府支出時幾乎必用。instruction 是指示、construction 是興建這個動作、institution 是機構或制度，都不能涵蓋整個交通系統。

stem: Several countries have now added basic coding to the primary school ____ , alongside traditional subjects such as mathematics and reading.
explain_zh: curriculum 是「課程內容、課綱」，前面有 the 且句中只講一套課程，要用單數；複數是 curricula。教育題組常寫 the national curriculum。certificate 是證書、criterion 是評斷標準，語意都不合。

stem: Cuts to the ____ system have been blamed for the sharp rise in the number of families who now rely on food banks.
explain_zh: welfare 是「社會福利」，the welfare system/state 是討論貧富差距與政府責任時的核心字。warfare 是「戰爭行為」，只差一個字母卻完全不同，是常見誤用；wellbeing 是個人的身心安康、farewell 是道別。

stem: Tax reductions give manufacturers a strong financial ____ to invest in cleaner technology instead of simply paying for pollution permits.
explain_zh: incentive 是「誘因、動機」，Task 2 談政策設計時常寫 provide an incentive for people to do something。intensive 是形容詞（密集的）、initiative 是主動推出的方案、intention 是個人意圖，都不能表示「讓人願意去做的外在誘因」。

stem: Without strict government ____ , companies have very little reason to test new chemicals thoroughly before releasing them onto the market.
explain_zh: regulation 是「法規、管制」，environment 與 technology 題組常寫 stricter regulation of social media。regularity 是「規律性」、registration 是登記註冊、reputation 是名聲，都不能表示政府的監管制度。

stem: Cities that invest heavily in cycle lanes and bus services usually suffer far less from traffic ____ than those that keep building roads.
explain_zh: congestion 是「（交通）壅塞」，traffic congestion 與 congestion charge 都是雅思交通題組的固定用語。conjunction 是連接詞或結合、concession 是讓步或優惠、confusion 是困惑，都不能形容塞車。

stem: The new standards will require every new vehicle to cut its carbon ____ by at least forty percent before the end of this decade.
explain_zh: emissions 是「（廢氣）排放量」，carbon emissions、greenhouse gas emissions 是環境題組出現頻率最高的詞組。omission 是遺漏、admission 是入學許可或承認、permission 是許可，三個字尾相近卻完全不同。

stem: Adult ____ programmes have helped thousands of people who left school early to read official letters and job advertisements on their own.
explain_zh: literacy 是「識字、讀寫能力」，教育與發展中國家題組常寫 the adult literacy rate；延伸還有 digital literacy。literature 是文學作品、literary 與 literal 是形容詞，都不能當 programmes 前面的名詞修飾語。

stem: An ageing population means that the ____ is shrinking, and fewer taxpayers must support a steadily growing number of pensioners.
explain_zh: workforce 是「勞動人口、全體員工」，人口與就業題組常寫 women in the workforce。workload 是工作量、workshop 是工作坊、workplace 是工作場所，都不能表示「全國有工作能力的人口」。

stem: Rising ____ fees have made many school leavers think twice about applying to university straight after they finish their secondary education.
explain_zh: tuition fees 是「學費」，教育題組討論大學該不該免費時一定會用到。intuition 是直覺、tutorial 是小班輔導課、taxation 是稅制，雖然字形或主題相近，卻都不能和 fees 組成「學費」。

stem: People who ____ for more than an hour each day report lower levels of satisfaction with both their job and their family life.
explain_zh: commute 是「通勤」，可以當動詞也可以當名詞（a long commute），是交通與工作題組的必備字。compute 是計算、commit 是犯罪或承諾、commence 是開始，都不能表示每天往返上班。

stem: Investment in ____ energy has grown so quickly that solar power is now cheaper than coal in most of the world's major markets.
explain_zh: renewable energy 是「可再生能源」，環境與科技題組的固定詞組，指太陽能、風能、水力等。removable 是可拆卸的、renewed 是重新開始的、reusable 是可重複使用的（多半形容容器或袋子），都不能形容能源類型。

stem: Clearing forest for palm oil plantations causes a dramatic loss of ____ , since hundreds of species depend entirely on the original habitat.
explain_zh: biodiversity 是「生物多樣性」，環境題組談棲地破壞時最核心的名詞，常搭配 loss of biodiversity。biography 是傳記、biology 是生物學這門學科、diversion 是改道或消遣，都不是「物種的多樣性」。

stem: ____ in the Amazon basin not only destroys habitats but also releases huge quantities of stored carbon back into the atmosphere.
explain_zh: deforestation 是「砍伐森林」，環境題組的高頻名詞，動詞形式是 clear/cut down forests。reforestation 是「重新造林」方向完全相反；deportation 是驅逐出境；deterioration 是惡化，語意太籠統也不會釋放林中碳。

stem: Campaigners warn that constant ____ in public spaces may help prevent crime but also threatens the privacy of ordinary citizens.
explain_zh: surveillance 是「監視、監控」，科技與犯罪題組常寫 CCTV surveillance、mass surveillance。supervision 是老師或主管對人的督導、surveying 是測量或問卷調查、resilience 是韌性，都不能指公共場所的攝影機監控。

stem: Childhood ____ has become a serious public health issue in countries where cheap, high-sugar food is available on almost every street.
explain_zh: obesity 是「肥胖（症）」，健康題組討論飲食與運動時的核心名詞，形容詞是 obese。obscurity 是默默無聞、obedience 是服從、absence 是缺席，都和公共衛生問題無關。

stem: Japan's rapidly ____ population has forced the government to rethink its pension system and to encourage more people to work after sixty.
explain_zh: an ageing population 是「高齡化人口」，人口題組的固定說法，注意要用現在分詞表示「正在變老的過程」。aged 是「年齡為……的」用法不同、agreeing 是同意、ancient 是古代的，都不能形容人口結構的變化。

stem: Seasonal ____ from the countryside to the cities rises sharply whenever the harvest fails in the northern provinces of the country.
explain_zh: migration 是「遷徙」，不限國內或國外，國內城鄉移動只能用它。immigration 專指「移入某國」、emigration 專指「移出某國」，兩者都跨國，用在國內移動就不精準；integration 是融合，語意不同。

stem: The city council has promised to build five thousand ____ homes for families who cannot compete in the private rental market.
explain_zh: affordable housing 是「負擔得起的住宅」，住房題組的固定詞組，Task 2 談年輕人買不起房時一定用得到。affordably 是副詞不能修飾名詞、favourable 是有利的、comfortable 是舒適的，都不強調價格可負擔。

stem: Germany's ____ training system allows teenagers to combine classroom study with paid work in a local company, and many stay on afterwards.
explain_zh: vocational training/education 是「職業訓練」，教育題組比較學術路線與技職路線時的必備詞。vacational 幾乎不使用（vacation 是度假）、national 是全國的、optional 是可選修的，都不能表示以就業為導向的訓練。

stem: Farmers receive a government ____ for every hectare of land that they leave as wildflower meadow instead of ploughing it.
explain_zh: subsidy 是「補助金」，動詞是 subsidise，農業、能源、公共運輸題組都常見。subsidiary 是子公司或附屬的、substitute 是替代品、supplement 是補充品或增補資料，都不是政府發放的金錢補助。

stem: Although most households now separate their rubbish carefully, the ____ rate in this city is still below the national average.
explain_zh: the recycling rate 是「回收率」，環境題組談垃圾處理時的固定說法，動名詞在這裡當名詞修飾語。recycled 是「被回收過的」形容成品、reusing 與 reducing 不能和 rate 組成固定詞組。

stem: Better nutrition and wider access to medical care have raised average life ____ in the region by almost fifteen years since 1970.
explain_zh: life expectancy 是「平均壽命」，健康與人口題組的固定詞組，Task 1 的人口統計圖也常出現。life expectation 不是正確搭配（expectation 指心理上的期待）、expense 是花費、experience 是經驗。

stem: The pandemic exposed the digital ____ , as children without a laptop or a stable internet connection quickly fell behind their classmates.
explain_zh: the digital divide 是「數位落差」，科技與教育題組的固定名詞，指有無科技資源造成的不平等。division 是部門或分割這個動作、dividend 是股息、divergence 是分歧，都不能組成這個固定詞組。

stem: Flexible hours and the option of working from home are usually introduced to improve employees' work-life ____ rather than to cut costs.
explain_zh: work-life balance 是「工作與生活的平衡」，工作題組的固定詞組，Task 2 談加班文化時很實用。balanced 是形容詞、burden 是負擔、bargain 是划算的交易，都無法組成這個固定搭配。

stem: An efficient and affordable public ____ network is probably the most effective way of reducing the number of private cars in a city centre.
explain_zh: public transport 是「大眾運輸」，交通題組的核心詞組，英式雅思用 transport，美式才說 transit。transaction 是交易、transition 是轉型過渡、transmission 是傳輸或傳染，都不能組成這個詞組。

stem: The ____ of the national railway was supposed to improve services, but ticket prices have risen faster than inflation ever since.
explain_zh: privatisation 是「民營化」，動詞是 privatise，經濟與公共服務題組常用，反義是 nationalisation。privacy 是隱私、privilege 是特權、deprivation 是匱乏剝奪，都不能表示把國營事業轉為民營。

stem: A genuine ____ arises when somebody has to choose between two options that are equally unattractive, such as cutting wages or cutting jobs.
explain_zh: dilemma 專指「兩難」，也就是兩個選項都不好、非選一個不可，題目後半正是這個定義。problem 泛指任何麻煩、obstacle 是擋在路上的障礙、drawback 是某方案的缺點，都沒有「二選一都不好」的意思。

stem: For most students the main ____ to studying abroad is not academic ability but the cost of tuition and daily living expenses.
explain_zh: obstacle 是「阻礙、絆腳石」，指擋住你達成目標的東西，常說 the main obstacle to doing something。dilemma 是兩難、objection 是反對意見、obligation 是義務，都不是「妨礙你出國念書的東西」。

stem: Climate change is no longer a scientific ____ alone; it has clearly become a political and an economic one as well.
explain_zh: issue 指「大家在討論、有不同立場的議題」，Task 2 開頭常寫 This is a controversial issue。dilemma 是兩難、obstacle 是障礙、trouble 偏口語且多指麻煩事，都不能表示公共議題。

stem: Getting enough sleep on the night before the test is absolutely ____ ; without it, even the best-prepared candidates start to make careless mistakes.
explain_zh: crucial 是「至關重要的」，語氣比 important 強，Task 2 強調某因素不可或缺時很好用。casual 是隨意的、cautious 是謹慎的、curious 是好奇的，字首相近但語意完全不同。

stem: Water is absolutely ____ to life; no known organism on Earth can survive without it for more than a few days.
explain_zh: vital 原意和「生命」有關，強調「沒有它就活不下去」，所以 vital to life/vital organs 最精準；important 在這裡就顯得太弱。valid 是有效的、vague 是模糊的、various 是各式各樣的，語意都不合。

stem: Buying rice and flour in bulk is far more ____ for a large family, since the price per kilogram falls sharply.
explain_zh: economical 是「省錢的、划算的」，形容做法或產品；economic 則是「經濟（層面）的」，如 economic growth，兩者常被混用。economics 是經濟學這門學科、economy 是名詞（經濟體），詞性也不對。

stem: The new boiler is highly ____ : it produces exactly the same amount of heat while using about a third less gas.
explain_zh: efficient 強調「投入少、產出一樣多」，也就是不浪費資源，正好對應題目的「少用三分之一的瓦斯」。effective 強調「有沒有達到效果」，不管成本；effectual 很少用；affective 是「情感的」，語意完全不同。

stem: Rising sea temperatures ____ fish populations far beyond the coastal areas where the warming itself has actually been recorded and measured.
explain_zh: affect 是動詞「影響」，effect 一般是名詞「影響、效果」（have an effect on），這組是雅思寫作最常被扣分的拼字混淆。effective 是形容詞、affection 是名詞（情感），詞性都不對。

stem: The report carefully measures the environmental ____ of the factory, including the water it uses and the waste it produces.
explain_zh: impact 指「衝擊、具體造成的影響」，environmental impact 是固定詞組（還有 impact assessment）。influence 偏向潛移默化地左右想法或行為，不能和 environmental 搭配；impression 是印象、importance 是重要性。

stem: The government now plans to ____ the retirement age to sixty-eight, a decision that has angered many of the country's trade unions.
explain_zh: raise 是及物動詞，後面一定要接受詞（raise the age/prices/taxes）；rise 是不及物動詞，東西自己上升，不能接受詞，這組動詞在 Task 1 描述圖表時尤其容易寫錯。arise 是問題發生、raising 詞形不合。

stem: A surprising ____ of first-year students admitted in the questionnaire that they had never once used the main university library.
explain_zh: number 用於可數名詞（a number of students），amount 則用於不可數名詞（the amount of water），這是雅思寫作最常見的扣分點。quantity 多用於不可數或商品數量、a deal 要寫成 a great deal of 且接不可數名詞。

stem: The sheer ____ of plastic waste produced worldwide every year is now measured in hundreds of millions of tonnes, and it is still growing.
explain_zh: waste 是不可數名詞，所以要用 the amount of；如果是可數的 bottles 就要改成 the number of。count 當名詞是計次、sum 是金額總和，都不能用來講廢棄物的總量。

stem: The ____ reason for the decline is not the price of tickets but the poor reliability of the service itself.
explain_zh: principal 當形容詞是「主要的」（the principal reason/cause），principle 則是名詞「原則」，兩字發音相同是經典易混淆組。principally 是副詞不能修飾名詞、prince 是王子，語意完全不合。

stem: Smoking remains by far the leading ____ of preventable death in most developed countries, well ahead of both road accidents and alcohol.
explain_zh: cause 指客觀上造成某結果的原因，the cause of death 是固定搭配；reason 偏向人做某事的理由，不能說 the reason of death。effect 是結果、purpose 是目的，方向正好相反。

stem: One clear ____ of cycling to work is that it improves your health while costing you almost nothing at all.
explain_zh: benefit 是「好處」，可以是健康、環境或社會層面，Task 2 列優點時最常用。profit 專指金錢上的利潤、income 是收入、bonus 是額外獎金，都把「好處」窄化成金錢，和句中的健康益處不符。

stem: The company reported a record ____ of eight million dollars last year, most of which was returned to its shareholders.
explain_zh: profit 是「利潤」，收入扣掉成本後的錢，才能加上金額並分給股東。benefit 與 advantage 是抽象的好處不能用金額計算；earning 單數幾乎不用，要用複數 earnings。

stem: Studying abroad gave her the ____ to improve her English and to build a professional network at the same time.
explain_zh: opportunity 是「（可以好好利用的）機會」，固定用法是 the opportunity to do something。possibility 指事情有沒有可能發生、occasion 是特定場合、probability 是機率，都不能接不定詞表示「讓她得以做某事的機會」。

stem: The stadium has a ____ of sixty thousand, but safety regulations mean that only fifty thousand tickets are ever sold.
explain_zh: capacity 指「容納量、容量」，場館、電池、工廠產能都用它。capability 與 ability 是「人或組織的能力」，不能形容場地能坐多少人；volume 是體積或音量，也不合。

stem: The engine of the ferry produces a ____ hum that never stops, which makes conversation inside the passenger cabin surprisingly difficult.
explain_zh: continuous 是「中間完全不中斷」，對應題目的 never stops；continual 則是「一再重複但有間隔」，例如 continual interruptions。continued 與 continuing 通常表示「持續存在的」狀態，不強調毫無停頓。

stem: It would be far more ____ to book the flight now, since prices always rise sharply during the holiday season.
explain_zh: sensible 是「明智的、合理的」，形容決定或做法；sensitive 是「敏感的」，形容人或儀器，這兩字是雅思常考的混淆組。sensory 是感官的、senseless 是毫無意義的，語意都不對。

stem: ____ the government has invested heavily in public transport over the past decade, private car ownership has continued to rise.
explain_zh: Although 是從屬連接詞，後面接完整子句（主詞＋動詞），這是 Task 2 寫讓步句最安全的結構。Despite 後面只能接名詞或動名詞、However 是副詞要用分號或句號隔開、Because 的因果方向和後半句矛盾。

stem: The report, ____ was published only last month, argues that remote working has permanently changed the centres of large cities.
explain_zh: 逗號後的非限定關係子句只能用 which，不能用 that，這是雅思寫作補充說明時的高分句型。it 會造成兩個主詞的逗點連寫（comma splice）；what 不能當關係代名詞接在名詞後面。

stem: Students ____ first language is not English often need extra time to finish the reading section of the test.
explain_zh: 空格後面是名詞 first language，表示「學生的母語」，所有格關係代名詞要用 whose。who 與 whom 後面不能直接接名詞；which 只能指物，且同樣不能表示所有格。

stem: ____ with steadily rising fuel prices, a large number of commuters have switched from driving to cycling or taking the bus.
explain_zh: be faced with 是固定用法，分詞構句省略 being 之後就以過去分詞 Faced 開頭，Task 2 描述「面臨某問題」時很好用。Facing 後面不接 with、Face 是原形動詞、To face 表示目的，語意不合。

stem: Having ____ the data from all four regions, the researchers concluded that the two variables were only weakly related.
explain_zh: Having + 過去分詞的完成式分詞構句，表示這個動作比主要子句更早發生，是學術寫作常見句型。analysing 與 analyse 詞形不合；been analysed 是被動，但研究者是主動去分析資料的人。

stem: If governments ____ acted sooner, the cost of adapting to climate change would be far lower than it is today.
explain_zh: 這是混合條件句：if 子句講過去沒做的事（had acted），主要子句講現在的結果（would be），Task 2 檢討政策失誤時很實用。have、has 時態不對；would have 不能出現在 if 子句裡。

stem: Not only ____ the policy reduce congestion in the city centre, but it also cut levels of air pollution by almost a fifth.
explain_zh: Not only 放句首要倒裝，把助動詞提到主詞前面，後半句用過去式 cut，所以要用 did。it did 沒有倒裝、does 時態與 cut 不符、has 後面必須接過去分詞。

stem: The main reason ____ so many graduates move to the capital is that almost all the well-paid jobs are located there.
explain_zh: 先行詞是 reason 時，關係副詞要用 why（或 that，或直接省略），後面接完整子句。which 是關係代名詞，後面的子句不能是完整句；because 不能接在名詞後面當關係詞；for 在這裡缺少受詞。

stem: It is the lack of affordable housing, rather than the number of jobs, ____ forces young people to leave the region.
explain_zh: 這是強調句型 It is ... that ...，不管強調的是人、事還是原因，連接詞一律用 that，Task 2 想突出關鍵因素時很好用。which 不能用在強調句型、what 不能接在名詞後、it 會造成句子結構錯亂。

stem: ____ the survey was conducted entirely online, people without regular internet access were automatically excluded from the sample.
explain_zh: Since 在這裡是「既然、因為」，後面接完整子句說明原因，適合用來解釋研究方法的限制。Despite 與 In spite of 表示讓步且後面只能接名詞，Due to 也只能接名詞片語。

stem: The company has agreed to keep its factory in the region ____ the government offers a substantial reduction in local taxes.
explain_zh: provided that 表示「只要／條件是」，是 Task 2 談政策條件時的正式說法。unless 意思是「除非」，會變成「除非減稅否則就留下」語意矛盾；whereas 表示對比；in case 是「以防萬一」，都講不通。

stem: Many teenagers spend several hours a day on social media, ____ can affect both their sleep and their concentration at school.
explain_zh: 這裡的 which 指前面「整件事」，叫做句子關係子句，Task 2 補充說明後果時很好用。that 不能用在逗號後的非限定子句；what 不能指代前面的整句話；it 會造成逗點連寫。

stem: The island, ____ most of the residents work in tourism or fishing, suffered badly during the two years of travel restrictions.
explain_zh: 空格後面是完整句子（most of the residents work...），且先行詞是地點，所以要用關係副詞 where。which 與 that 是關係代名詞，後面的子句必須缺主詞或受詞；when 用於時間。

stem: ____ he submitted the essay before the deadline, he would not have lost ten percent of his final mark.
explain_zh: Had he submitted 是 If he had submitted 的倒裝形式，省略 if 之後把 had 提前，語氣更正式，適合寫作拿高分。選 If 會變成 If he submitted，與後面的 would not have lost 時態不搭；Should 與 Were 的倒裝形式也不合。

stem: The researchers examined two thousand essays, ____ of which showed clear signs of memorised phrases copied from model answers.
explain_zh: essays 是可數複數，所以用 many of which；much 只能接不可數名詞。a lot 與 plenty 後面必須加 of 才能接名詞，寫成 a lot of which 才通，單獨放在 of which 前面是錯的。

stem: ____ the two cities are very similar in size and climate, their approaches to waste management are completely different.
explain_zh: While 在這裡是「雖然、儘管」，後面接完整子句，Task 2 比較兩個對象時非常實用。Despite 後面只能接名詞或動名詞、However 是連接副詞不能直接連接兩個子句、Moreover 表示additionally，邏輯不對。

stem: The scheme eventually failed ____ a lack of funding but because local residents were never properly consulted.
explain_zh: 後半句是 but because，前面必須用 not because of 才能形成 not because of A but because B 的對比結構。其餘三個都是肯定的「因為」，會和 but because 互相矛盾，也失去對比效果。

stem: By the time the new hospital finally opens, the population of the district ____ by more than twenty percent.
explain_zh: By the time + 現在式子句，主要子句要用未來完成式 will have grown，表示「到那時候為止已經完成」。will grow 沒有「在那之前完成」的意思、has grown 少了未來的時間點、grew 是過去式，時態全都不合。

stem: Very few people realise ____ much energy is wasted simply by leaving electronic devices on standby overnight.
explain_zh: 空格後面是 much energy，要用 how much 這個疑問詞組來引導名詞子句。what 不能直接接 much、that 後面必須是完整子句且不含疑問詞、which 需要在有限選項中做選擇，語意不合。

stem: ____ in 1887 and widened twice since then, the bridge still carries more than fifty thousand vehicles every single day.
explain_zh: 過去分詞開頭的分詞構句表示被動（橋是被建造的），可以精簡句子，是雅思寫作提升句型變化的好方法。Building 是主動語態、To build 表示目的、It built 會造成兩個主要子句沒有連接詞。

stem: ____ of the new curriculum has been delayed until next September because many schools still lack trained teachers.
explain_zh: 名詞化就是把動詞 implement 變成名詞 implementation 當主詞，讓句子更精簡、更學術，是 Task 2 拿高分的關鍵手法。The implement 是「工具」語意不合、Implemented 是過去分詞、To implementation 文法不通。

stem: The government's ____ to reduce carbon emissions quickly has been criticised by scientists as well as by younger voters.
explain_zh: 所有格 the government's 後面要接名詞，所以用 failure；failure to do something 是學術寫作常見結構，比 the government did not succeed 精簡許多。fail、failed、fails 都是動詞形式，不能放在所有格後面。

stem: A sharp ____ in house prices followed the central bank's decision to raise interest rates for the third time.
explain_zh: 冠詞 a 加形容詞 sharp 之後必須是名詞，所以要用 reduction；Task 1 用「形容詞＋名詞化」描述變化（a sharp reduction）比用動詞更簡潔。reduce 是動詞、reduced 是過去分詞、reducing 在此無法當主詞名詞。

stem: Instead of writing that people are becoming poorer, an academic writer would usually refer to the ____ of poverty.
explain_zh: 名詞化讓句子聚焦在現象本身，the growth of poverty 就是把 people are becoming poorer 濃縮成名詞片語。grow 是動詞、grown 是過去分詞、the growing of poverty 不是英文慣用說法。

stem: The ____ of social media on teenage sleep patterns has attracted a great deal of research attention in recent years.
explain_zh: The ... of ... on ... 的結構中間要放名詞，influence 名詞動詞同形，這裡當名詞用。influential 是形容詞、influenced 是過去分詞、influencing 是動名詞但不能搭配 the...of 這個結構。

stem: Careful ____ of the results shows that the difference between the two groups is much smaller than the authors claim.
explain_zh: 形容詞 careful 後面要接名詞，analysis 是 analyse 的名詞形，Careful analysis of X shows that... 是學術寫作的經典開頭。analyse 是動詞、analytic 是形容詞、analysed 是過去分詞。

stem: ____ in renewable energy has risen sharply since 2010, particularly in countries with generous government subsidies.
explain_zh: 句首當主詞要用名詞，Investment in X has risen 是 Task 1 與 Task 2 都能用的句型。Invest 是動詞、Invested 是過去分詞、Investor 是「投資人」，語意上人不會「上升」。

stem: The ____ of English as a global language has changed the way in which universities all over the world design their courses.
explain_zh: the ... of 中間必須是名詞，emergence 是 emerge 的名詞形，the emergence of 是介紹某現象興起的高分句型。emerge 是動詞、emerged 是過去分詞、emergent 是形容詞。

stem: There has been a significant ____ in the quality of the drinking water since the new treatment plant opened.
explain_zh: There has been a + 形容詞 + 名詞 是描述變化的萬用句型，這裡要用名詞 improvement，Task 1 特別常用。improve 是動詞、improved 是過去分詞、improving 不能接在 a significant 之後當名詞。

stem: Government ____ of the banking sector was tightened considerably after the financial crisis of 2008.
explain_zh: 名詞 Government 後面要接另一個名詞組成複合名詞片語，regulation of X 是政策討論的標準說法。regulate 是動詞、regulated 是過去分詞、regular 是形容詞（規律的），語意也不對。

stem: The ____ between the two variables turned out to be much weaker than the research team had originally expected.
explain_zh: the relationship between A and B 是學術寫作描述兩者關聯的標準名詞化說法，比 A and B are related 更適合正式文章。relate 是動詞、related 是形容詞、relating 是現在分詞，都不能接在 The 後面當主詞。

stem: Widespread ____ to the proposal forced the council to hold a second public consultation before making any final decision.
explain_zh: 形容詞 Widespread 後面要接名詞，opposition to something 是「對某事的反對」，Task 2 描述民意反彈時很好用。oppose 是動詞、opposed 是過去分詞（be opposed to）、opposite 是「相反的」，語意不同。

stem: The available data suggest that online learning ____ be less effective for very young children, although further research is clearly needed.
explain_zh: may 表示「有可能」，正是學術寫作要的保守語氣，和後半句「還需要更多研究」完全一致。must 是強烈斷定、will 是肯定的預測、cannot 是斷然否定，三者都太武斷，在 Task 2 容易被評為過度概括。

stem: Young drivers ____ to take more risks on the road than older and more experienced drivers do.
explain_zh: tend to + 原形動詞是「傾向於」，可以避免把話說死，主詞 Young drivers 是複數所以用 tend。tends 是第三人稱單數形、tending 與 tendency 詞性不合，tendency 要寫成 have a tendency to。

stem: It ____ likely that sea levels will rise by at least half a metre before the end of this century.
explain_zh: It is likely that... 是學術寫作最常用的模糊限制句型，比 Sea levels will definitely rise 謹慎得多。虛主詞 It 是單數所以不能用 are；has 與 would 都無法和形容詞 likely 組成這個句型。

stem: Rather than writing that this proves the point, a cautious writer would say that the evidence ____ a strong link.
explain_zh: suggest 是學術寫作的標準模糊動詞，表示資料「顯示可能有」而不是「證明一定有」。prove、confirm、guarantee 語氣都太強，而且題目已經明說要避免 prove 這種說法。

stem: Overall, the results ____ to support the original hypothesis, though two of the six groups behaved unexpectedly.
explain_zh: appear to + 原形動詞是「看起來似乎」，是很自然的保留語氣，主詞 results 是複數所以用 appear。appears 是單數形、appearing 是現在分詞、appearance 是名詞，詞性都不對。

stem: Air pollution is ____ one of the main causes of childhood asthma in densely populated urban areas.
explain_zh: arguably 是副詞「可以說是」，插在 be 動詞後面可以把強烈主張軟化，是雅思寫作很好用的小詞。arguable 是形容詞、argued 是過去分詞、argument 是名詞，放在這個位置文法都不通。

stem: Such policies ____ not work equally well in countries that have very different tax systems and levels of income.
explain_zh: might not 表示「可能不會」，保留了例外的空間，適合 Task 2 談政策移植到別國的限制。must not 是「禁止」、shall not 語氣太法律化、ought 必須寫成 ought not to，都不符合語境。

stem: In many cases, students who read widely outside class ____ to achieve higher scores in the academic writing test.
explain_zh: be likely to + 原形動詞是「有可能」，主詞是人時比 It is likely that 更直接好用。likely 前面少了 be 動詞、are like 是「像……一樣」語意不同、likelihood 是名詞，都不能接不定詞。

stem: It is ____ assumed that new technology always improves productivity, but the evidence from several industries is mixed.
explain_zh: It is widely assumed/believed/accepted that... 是介紹普遍看法卻不表態的經典句型，Task 2 開頭段很好用。wide 是形容詞、widen 是動詞、widening 是現在分詞，都不能修飾過去分詞 assumed。

stem: The findings ____ towards a link between screen time and poor sleep, but the sample was far too small to be conclusive.
explain_zh: point towards/to 是「（證據）指向某個方向」，語氣謹慎，正好呼應後半句樣本太小的限制。prove、show、confirm 後面都不接 towards，而且語氣過於肯定，與 but 之後的保留衝突。

stem: To some ____ , the problem can be solved by better urban planning, but housing costs clearly play a part as well.
explain_zh: to some extent 是「在某種程度上」，Task 2 遇到 To what extent do you agree 題型時，用它表達部分同意最自然。extend 是動詞、extensive 是形容詞、extension 是延伸物，都不能組成這個片語。

stem: It is ____ that the new regulations contributed to the decline, although several other factors were clearly involved as well.
explain_zh: It is possible that... 的句型中，虛主詞 It 之後要接形容詞，所以用 possible。possibly 是副詞、possibility 是名詞（要寫成 There is a possibility that）、possibleness 幾乎不使用。

stem: The city opened two new bridges in 2015. ____ have significantly reduced travel times between the eastern and western districts.
explain_zh: 指涉前一句的複數名詞 two new bridges，要用 These（或 They），這種跨句指涉是 Task 2 段落連貫的基本功。This 與 It 是單數、Such 不能單獨當主詞，都和複數先行詞不一致。

stem: Some students clearly prefer working in groups; ____ concentrate far better when they are left on their own.
explain_zh: others 等於 other students，用來指「另外一些人」，Some..., others... 是雅思寫作對比兩群人的標準句型。other 是形容詞後面要接名詞、the other 指剩下的特定一個或一群、another 是單數。

stem: My laptop is considerably older than ____ , but it still runs every program I need for my coursework.
explain_zh: 比較句要拿「我的筆電」和「她的筆電」比，所以用所有格代名詞 hers 代替 her laptop，避免重複。her 是所有格形容詞後面要接名詞、her's 拼法根本不存在、she 是主格。

stem: She promised that she would rewrite the introduction before the deadline, and she ____ .
explain_zh: 用助動詞 did 代替整個動詞片語 rewrote the introduction，這叫替代（substitution），可以避免重複又保持連貫。does 時態不合、was 不能替代一般動詞、had 後面缺少過去分詞。

stem: If you still need a copy of the student handbook, the departmental office can print ____ for you this afternoon.
explain_zh: one 代替「同類中的任一本」，因為對方需要的是另外一本手冊，不是特指的那一本；it 會變成「就是剛剛提到的那一本」，語意不對。some 與 any 用於複數或不可數名詞。

stem: Tokyo has a considerably larger population than ____ city in Japan, and the gap has widened since 1990.
explain_zh: 同一群體內做比較時要用 than any other + 單數名詞，才不會把東京自己也算進去。any others 是代名詞後面不能接 city、other 前面缺少限定詞、another city 會變成「隨便另一個城市」，比較邏輯不完整。

stem: The scheme turned out to be expensive, time-consuming and ____ , so the council quietly abandoned it after two years.
explain_zh: and 前後要保持平行結構，前面是兩個形容詞，第三項也必須是形容詞片語 difficult to manage。it was difficult 是完整子句、後兩個選項詞序與詞性都不合，破壞平行結構會直接影響文法分數。

stem: Good writers plan their essays carefully, ____ their ideas logically and leave enough time to check the final draft.
explain_zh: 三個動作要平行排列：plan、organise、leave 都用原形（配合主詞現在式），Task 2 列舉步驟時特別容易寫錯。organising、to organise、organised 都和前後的 plan、leave 形式不一致。

stem: The policy has two clear aims: to reduce the amount of household waste and ____ the proportion that is recycled.
explain_zh: 冒號後面列出兩個目的，第一個是 to reduce，第二個也必須是 to increase，維持不定詞的平行。increasing 是動名詞、increase of 與 for increasing 都和前面的結構對不起來。

stem: Ticket prices rose sharply in 2018. ____ , passenger numbers continued to grow steadily throughout that year.
explain_zh: 票價漲、乘客卻繼續增加，兩句是「出乎意料」的轉折，要用 Nevertheless（或 However）。Therefore 表示因果、Moreover 表示補充、For example 表示舉例，邏輯關係全都不對。

stem: The town has had no railway station since 1968. ____ , most residents now depend on an hourly bus service.
explain_zh: 沒有火車站是原因，依賴公車是結果，所以用表示結果的 Consequently（或 As a result）。However 與 In contrast 表示對比、Similarly 表示相似，都無法連接這組因果關係。

stem: Renewable energy is becoming steadily cheaper. ____ , it now employs more people worldwide than the coal industry does.
explain_zh: 兩句都是再生能源的優點，屬於同方向的補充，要用 Furthermore（或 In addition）。Otherwise 表示「否則」、Instead 表示取代、Nonetheless 表示讓步轉折，邏輯方向都錯了。

stem: Several factors help to explain the decline. The ____ important of these is almost certainly the falling birth rate.
explain_zh: 三個以上的因素比較要用最高級 the most important；of these 也提示範圍在三者以上。more 是比較級用於兩者、much 不能這樣修飾、very 不能和 the 加形容詞組成最高級結構。

stem: Cycling is cheap, quiet and good for your health; ____ is why the council is building forty kilometres of new cycle lanes.
explain_zh: that 在這裡指前面整句話，形成 That is why...（這就是為什麼）的銜接句型，Task 2 收尾很好用。it 不能指代整個句子當主詞、what is why 不合文法、which 前面必須有逗號且不能當獨立子句的主詞。

stem: Students who revise regularly usually perform better than ____ who leave all their reading until the final week.
explain_zh: those who 是「那些……的人」的固定用法，用來代替 the students，避免重複同一個名詞。that 是單數、these 指近處且較少接 who、them 是受格不能當比較對象的主詞。

stem: The article lists three main benefits, the last of ____ is rarely mentioned in newspaper reports on the subject.
explain_zh: the last of which 是 of + 關係代名詞的用法，把兩個子句合成一句，是很漂亮的學術銜接結構。them 是代名詞會造成逗點連寫、that 不能放在介系詞 of 後面、what 不能當關係代名詞。
